description: This Java source file defines a service called 'SampleHotwordDetectionService' which extends Android's 'HotwordDetectionService'. It handles hotword detection events, manages audio recording for hotword detection, and processes detected hotwords including creating and releasing audio recordings.

classes.name: SampleHotwordDetectionService
classes.description: An Android service that handles hotword detection events, manages audio recording, and processes detected hotwords.

methods.name: createAudioRecord
methods.description: Creates an AudioRecord object configured for hotword detection with specified audio format and session ID.

methods.name: getBufferSizeInBytes
methods.description: Calculates buffer size in bytes given bytes per second and buffer length in seconds.

methods.name: onUpdateState
methods.description: Handles updates to the service state, optionally reporting status via callback.

methods.name: onDetect
methods.description: Handles hotword detection events, creating and managing audio recording, and invoking callbacks upon detection.

methods.name: getKeyphraseId
methods.description: Returns a keyphrase ID, currently a placeholder returning 0.
